paper_title: 3D template-based $Fermi$-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Diffuse SN ALP background constraint from 12 years of Fermi-LAT data. Benchmark 95% CL upper limit g_agamma < 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a << 10^-11 eV. Systematic range [2.38, 7.04]e-11. Mass-independent bound encoded as horizontal line valid for m_a << 10^-11 eV; range endpoints chosen within the stated validity region.
